pilot.reuse_policy: reuse only declared, completed equivalent runs with matched provenance and recorded numerical-equivalence evidence
pilot.selection_metric: mean clean development cross-entropy over rounds 4-6 and all three seeds
pilot.tie_break: closest relative rate to one in log space, then smaller relative rate
pilot.candidate_failure_policy: record failure; ineligible if any seed is incomplete or nonfinite; no replacement candidate
pilot.selection_scope: pilot recommendation only; does not select final research settings
pilot.grid_boundary_policy: flag boundary winner for later review; do not add candidates after viewing this pilot

invariants.published_defence_parameters: hold existing declared defaults fixed during server calibration
invariants.viceroy_aggregation: raw weighted sum multiplied by a fixed server learning rate; never divide by observed weight mass
invariants.fltrust_scaling: retain ReLU trust and root-norm rescaling; internal global rate one, external server rate applied once
invariants.client_optimizer: identical configuration and fresh optimizer each round for every method
invariants.pairing: within each seed, same partition, selected images, initialization, client order and shuffle seeds
invariants.aggregation_inputs: no scenario, validation results or simulator truth
invariants.trusted_data: 300 fixed reserved clean root examples for FLTrust only; disjoint from clients and validation; disclose this assumption
invariants.rfa_budget: three refinements plus one initial weighted mean; record actual averaging operations
invariants.original_results: preserve notebooks 01-08 and their artifacts; label calibrated variants explicitly

step_7_tuning_procedure_draft.configuration_budget: three predeclared server rates times up to four predeclared defence configurations; unused slots are not transferred between methods
step_7_tuning_procedure_draft.defence_candidates: source-justified grids for published baselines; FedReTrust grid after step 5; exact lists frozen before tuning
step_7_tuning_procedure_draft.numerical_tolerances: fixed numerical policies, not accuracy-tuning parameters
step_7_tuning_procedure_draft.shared_training_budget: same architecture, local training, participation and rounds for each configuration
step_7_tuning_procedure_draft.validation_design: shared IID/non-IID development partitions and scenarios; same seed set for each candidate
step_7_tuning_procedure_draft.selection_objective: finalize a common task/scenario weighting and recovery metrics in step 3; freeze before step 7 tuning
step_7_tuning_procedure_draft.selection_unit: one declared setting per method and partition regime, held fixed across attack and drift scenarios; no per-scenario cherry-picking
step_7_tuning_procedure_draft.failures: record and count attempted configurations against budget; distinguish infrastructure failure from numerical instability
step_7_tuning_procedure_draft.grid_changes: version and disclose any revision before a new tuning suite; retain all prior exploratory results and budgets
step_7_tuning_procedure_draft.freeze_record: save exact candidates, selection rule, selected settings, development/final seeds, data hashes and code hashes before final evaluation
step_7_tuning_procedure_draft.final_evaluation: official test data and independent final seeds only after the protocol freeze; no test-driven retuning
step_7_tuning_procedure_draft.status: procedure proposed for Astra/supervisor review; exact benchmark budget, grids and objective remain for steps 3, 5 and 7
